Samantha — thanks for sending those so quickly and for uploading to the portal. Quick clarifications after a preliminary review of the W-8BEN-E and incorporation doc: 

- FTIN requirement: For treaty benefits (reduced US withholding) Finance needs either a US EIN or the upstream country FTIN on the W-8BEN-E (your UTR is acceptable). Please confirm you have placed the UTR on line 10 (Part I) of the W-8BEN-E; if not, please update.

- Name/EIN mismatch & bank letter: The registration shows "BlueArc Solutions Ltd" but the W-8BEN-E PDF header here displays the trade name "BlueArc" in a few places. Finance flags small name variations and will request a bank letter if the payment account name differs from the legal entity name. The bank-letter-template I attached earlier is the preferred format; it can be on bank letterhead and signed by an authorized bank rep. Notarization is not strictly mandatory in every case, but when the bank letter and the certificate are in a country with different alphabets or formats, we ask for notarization or a certified translation. For the UK docs you sent, notarization is optional — a signed bank letter on bank letterhead should suffice.

- UBO / authorized signer: We also need the authorized signer's full name and a corporate email (for DocuSign routing). If the authorized signer on the W-8BEN-E differs from the incorporation signer, please upload ID for the signer who completed the W-8BEN-E.

Next steps I can take once you confirm/update:
1) If you confirm the UTR is on the W-8BEN-E, I'll request Finance to apply treaty rate and proceed to provisional PO creation.
2) If the bank account name on the remittance differs from the legal name, please upload the bank letter (template attached).
3) If translations are required we will accept an accredited certified translation (scan + translator statement).

Quick ask: can you confirm whether BlueArc will accept the PO under the legal name shown on the certificate (BlueArc Solutions Ltd) or do you require the PO to reference the trade name? That determines how Finance sets up the payment account.

I'll keep Priyom in the loop for the PO routing.

Thanks — Karthik
